BiblicalUsage: Gibath is a place, named once in Scripture, in Joshua. The full story of the place lives in the Bible itself, and this study covers only the name’s use.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Gibath matters because God met His people in real places, not in abstractions. I hold that Gibath is worth knowing by name, even when the Bible says little about it.
